text:
Maya (ML PM): Quick async sync — catalog launch scrub. We have three open models in the intake queue: ember-7b, tide-3b, marlin-lite. Need clear owners, license signoff, perf profile, and a canary window. Who's owning which piece and ETA for canary?

Ali (ML Eng): Ember-7b is mine for runtime + perf. License check is pending from @Jordan. Perf benches running on staging; should have a short writeup by EOD.

Sam (Infra Eng): Tide-3b note — without fp16 kernels it’s far slower. I filed infra slot req #REQ-452 for a fp16-capable pool (submitted Mon). If that doesn't land we'll need a quantized fallback which will spike latency.

Jordan (Legal): I skimmed ember-7b license — there's an attribution clause that might need explicit README + TOS language. Can someone ping the upstream contact to confirm acceptable attribution text?

Maya (ML PM): @Jordan and @Matt — Matt, do you have the upstream contact for ember? Also I'm adding a simple status matrix we can keep updated: owner | license_status | perf_status | canary_slot.

Ali (ML Eng): Perf snapshot (quick paste):
```
ember-7b | stg-a | p95=120ms | p50=48ms | tokens/s=320
tide-3b  | stg-b | p95=300ms | p50=180ms | tokens/s=120 (no fp16)
marlin-lite | stg-c | p95=220ms | p50=90ms | tokens/s=200 (quantized)
```

Matt (Curation): I just pinged upstream and they confirmed they can add the attribution header. Jordan — can you confirm that pattern satisfies legal?

Jordan (Legal): Quick read: yes, explicit attribution in the README + a line in the model metadata (license: apache-2.0 + attribution) is fine. Once they confirm the exact wording I'm happy to mark ember-7b license_status=approved.

Sam (Infra Eng): Proposed canary window: Tue 14:00-16:00 PST (low-traffic slot). We'll run 10% traffic to canary with rollback tags ready. Need owner approvals for that time.

Maya (ML PM): Tue 14-16 PST works for me. Ali?

Ali (ML Eng): Works. One request: add an automatic fallback mapping for APAC users in case ember-7b latencies spike during canary — fallback to marlin-lite-v1. Also request that canary run include the KV-cache warmup script for accurate p95.

Derek (SRE): Noted. Runbook snippet for canary kick (dev-friendly):
```
curl -X POST https://deploy.redwood.internal/canary \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"model":"ember-7b","traffic":0.1,"tags":["canary-176123"]}'
```
I can execute the run if owners give explicit go and @deploy-bot posts a pre-check.

Matt (Curation): Upstream just confirmed the exact attribution string. Jordan, can you mark license_status=approved? If yes I'll update model metadata with the license and attribution fields.

Jordan (Legal): Approved. Marking license_status=approved for ember-7b. Note for metadata: "license: apache-2.0+attr", and add "attribution: 'Model authors: X; Dataset: Y'" in the README.

Maya (ML PM): Quick action item list (will maintain):
- Ember-7b: owner=Ali, license=approved (Jordan), perf=ali/stg (EOD writeup), canary=Tue 14:00-16:00 PST.
- Tide-3b: owner=Sam (infra needed), blocked on fp16 kernel (REQ-452). Perf degraded without fp16; fallback mapping to marlin-lite if slot unavailable.
- Marlin-lite: owner=Matt, serve as fallback for APAC, quant profile validated.
- Runbook: Derek to execute canary with deploy-bot pre-check.

Ali (ML Eng): I'll drop the perf EOD note and add the KV warmup script to canary checklist.

Sam (Infra Eng): I'll follow up on REQ-452 and post ETA by tomorrow morning.

Derek (SRE): I'll draft a one-paragraph rollback runbook and paste it into the canary thread once ready.

Maya (ML PM): Great — if nobody objects I’ll mark Tue canary and start the calendar invite + low-traffic routing.

Ali (ML Eng): +1

Sam (Infra Eng): +1

Jordan (Legal): +1

Matt (Curation): +1

deploy-bot: scheduled check will run 30 minutes before canary start and report health.

Maya (ML PM): Thanks all — ping here if anything blocks before EOD. :thumbsup:
